title: Storybook Ui Syntax Fix
description: Fix Vite/esbuild transform error in ui/react/index.tsx ModeDockTabBar blocking dev:storybook:ui.
summary: Fixed Storybook/Vite esbuild failure in ModeDockTabBar: renderTab was converted to a block body without closing `};`, which made forwardRef’s `});` parse as invalid. Restored implicit-return arrow form via `inactiveTabChromeClass(stackIndex)` helper (last tab before gap uses `modeDockInactiveTabBeforeGapClass`). Verified dev:storybook:ui serves ui/react/index.tsx (HTTP 200) and all 76 @semio-tech/ui-react tests pass.
